title: HUD entry guards skipped direct execution through a macOS path alias
symptom: The exact local 0.2.4 candidate installed both plugins and exited successfully with --hud, but created neither the Codex launcher nor Claude statusLine; installed status.mjs exited 0 with empty output.

rootCause.summary: macOS canonicalized /tmp to /private/tmp for the imported module while process.argv[1] retained /tmp, so literal path guards silently skipped direct-entry main bodies.

requestedOutcome: Accept canonical path aliases without import-time side effects, rebuild the candidate and repeat native Codex and Claude acceptance on its exact bytes.
decisions: Canonicalize both sides of each direct-entry comparison and retain the missing-argv guard.
Preserve the failed archive evidence and require a new digest before native rerun.

actions.description: Canonicalize three HUD entry guards and add alias/import regressions.
Run focused HUD tests and syntax checks.
Complete authenticated Claude interactive HUD acceptance; rebuilt entrypoints, native Codex HUD and installed Claude status-line transitions have passed within their recorded scopes.
